heading.en: Early life, staff academy and the Russo-Japanese War

body.zh-Hant: 據立陶宛通用百科全書，薩姆索諾夫1859年11月14日生於赫爾松省安德烈耶夫卡，曾參加1877至1878年的俄土戰爭，1884年畢業於聖彼得堡的尼古拉總參謀學院。另據斯巴達克斯教育出版社的資料，他後來出任伊莉莎白格勒騎兵學校校長。日俄戰爭期間（1904至1905年），他統率烏蘇里騎兵旅與西伯利亞哥薩克師。
body.en: According to the Lithuanian Universal Encyclopedia, Samsonov was born on 14 November 1859 at Andreyevka in Kherson Governorate, took part in the Russo-Turkish War of 1877–78, and in 1884 graduated from the Nikolaevsky General Staff Academy in St Petersburg. Spartacus Educational adds that he later became commandant of the Elisavetgrad Cavalry School. During the Russo-Japanese War (1904–05) he led the Ussuri Cavalry Brigade and a Siberian Cossack division.

citations.quote: 1884 baigė Generalinio štabo Nikolajaus akademiją Sankt Peterburge.
Samsonov eventually became commandant of the Elisavetgrad Cavalry School.
vadovavo Usūrio kavalerijos brigadai, Sibiro kazokų divizijai

heading.zh-Hant: 參謀長、頓河哥薩克阿塔曼與突厥斯坦總督
heading.en: Chief of staff, Don Cossack ataman and Governor-General of Turkestan

body.zh-Hant: 1906至1907年，薩姆索諾夫任華沙軍區參謀長；自1907年起任頓河哥薩克軍的最高阿塔曼。1909至1914年，他任突厥斯坦總督，並任突厥斯坦軍區部隊司令，同時兼七河哥薩克軍的最高阿塔曼。
body.en: From 1906 to 1907 Samsonov was chief of staff of the Warsaw Military District, and from 1907 he was chief (viceroy) ataman of the Don Cossack Host. From 1909 to 1914 he was Governor-General of Turkestan and commander of the troops of the Turkestan Military District, and also chief ataman of the Semirechye Cossack Host.

citations.quote: Nuo 1907 Dono kazokų kariuomenės vyriausiasis atamanas.

heading.zh-Hant: 第二集團軍與坦能堡之戰
heading.en: Second Army and the Battle of Tannenberg

body.zh-Hant: 第一次世界大戰期間，薩姆索諾夫指揮西北方面軍第二集團軍。在東普魯士作戰中，他於1914年8月26日至30日的坦能堡戰役遭到慘敗，其集團軍大部被包圍並被殲滅。他本人於1914年8月30日死於維倫貝格（今維爾巴克）附近；立陶宛通用百科全書寫他自殺，另有說法為心臟病發，哥倫比亞百科全書則寫他在戰場上開槍自盡。
body.en: During the First World War Samsonov commanded the 2nd Army of the Northwestern Front. In the East Prussian operation he suffered defeat at the Battle of Tannenberg (26–30 August 1914), and most of his army was surrounded and destroyed. He died on 30 August 1914 near Willenberg (now Wielbark); the Lithuanian encyclopedia says he killed himself (by other accounts he died of a heart attack), and the Columbia Encyclopedia says he shot himself on the battlefield.

body.zh-Hant: 據立陶宛通用百科全書，庫羅帕特金1848年3月29日生於普斯科夫省的舍舒里諾。十九世紀七、八十年代他參與征服中亞，並在1877至1878年的俄土戰爭中表現突出。他於1900年晉升步兵上將，1902年任侍從武官長。
body.en: According to the Lithuanian Universal Encyclopedia, Kuropatkin was born on 29 March 1848 at Shesurino in Pskov Governorate. In the 1870s and 1880s he took part in the conquest of Central Asia and distinguished himself in the Russo-Turkish War of 1877–78. He became General of Infantry in 1900 and adjutant general in 1902.

heading.en: War Minister and the Russo-Japanese War

body.zh-Hant: 庫羅帕特金1898至1904年任陸軍大臣。日俄戰爭（1904至1905年）期間，他在滿洲指揮軍隊（1904年10月至1905年3月，並任遠東武裝力量總司令），但未能取勝，在遼陽（1904年8至9月）與奉天（1905年2至3月）兩次戰役失利。
body.en: Kuropatkin was Minister of War from 1898 to 1904. During the Russo-Japanese War (1904–05) he commanded the army in Manchuria (October 1904–March 1905, and as commander-in-chief of the armed forces in the Far East) without success, losing at Liaoyang (August–September 1904) and Mukden (February–March 1905).

heading.zh-Hant: 北方面軍、突厥斯坦與晚年
heading.en: Northern Front, Turkestan and later life

body.zh-Hant: 第一次世界大戰期間，庫羅帕特金於1916年2至7月任北方面軍司令；1916至1917年任突厥斯坦總督，鎮壓了1916年的中亞起義。1917年二月革命後，他應塔什干代表蘇維埃的要求被捕並押往彼得格勒，後經臨時政府釋放。他退役後當過教師，著有軍事史與地理著作，於1925年1月16日卒於舍舒里諾。
body.en: During the First World War Kuropatkin was commander of the Northern Front from February to July 1916 and in 1916–17 Governor-General of Turkestan, where he suppressed the Central Asian uprising of 1916. After the February Revolution of 1917 he was arrested at the demand of the Tashkent Soviet of Deputies and taken to Petrograd, but was released by the Provisional Government. He retired, worked as a teacher, wrote works on military history and geography, and died on 16 January 1925 at Shesurino.

heading.en: Origins, the Boxer campaign and the Russo-Japanese War

body.zh-Hant: 據立陶宛通用百科全書，倫寧坎普1854年4月29日生於康諾費爾（今愛沙尼亞），出身波羅的海德意志家族。他參與鎮壓中國義和團（1899至1901年）；日俄戰爭（1904至1905年）時統率外貝加爾哥薩克師，因在朝鮮東北部的行動受批評。斯巴達克斯資料稱，奉天會戰後薩姆索諾夫指責他貽誤戰機，兩人動手互毆。
body.en: According to the Lithuanian Universal Encyclopedia, Rennenkampf was born on 29 April 1854 at Konofer (now Konuvere, Estonia) into a Baltic German family. He took part in suppressing the Boxer Rising in China (1899–1901); in the Russo-Japanese War (1904–05) he led the Transbaikal Cossack Division and was criticised for his actions in north-eastern Korea. Spartacus Educational says that after Mukden Samsonov accused him of letting him down and the two came to blows.

heading.zh-Hant: 西伯利亞鎮壓與維爾諾軍區
heading.en: Siberia and the Vilnius Military District

body.zh-Hant: 1905至1907年，倫寧坎普所率分遣隊參與鎮壓東西伯利亞的革命行動。他於1910年晉升騎兵上將，1913至1914年任維爾諾軍區部隊司令。
body.en: In 1905–07 a detachment under his command took part in suppressing revolutionary activity in Eastern Siberia. He became General of Cavalry in 1910 and in 1913–14 commanded the troops of the Vilnius Military District.

heading.zh-Hant: 第一集團軍、免職與被殺

body.zh-Hant: 1914年大戰爆發後，倫寧坎普指揮西北方面軍第一集團軍，在東普魯士（1914年8至9月）與羅茲（1914年11月）兩次作戰中失利，因而被解除集團軍職務，1915年被編入預備役，並被指責無能甚至叛國。1917年二月革命後他被捕，關押於彼得保羅要塞；十月政變後獲釋，前往塔甘羅格。他拒絕在紅軍服役，被契卡逮捕並槍決，死於1918年3月31日。
body.en: After the outbreak of war in 1914 Rennenkampf commanded the 1st Army of the Northwestern Front; after defeats in the East Prussian operation (August–September 1914) and at Łódź (November 1914) he was removed from the army command and in 1915 placed in the reserve, accused of incompetence and even treason. After the February Revolution of 1917 he was arrested and held in the Peter and Paul Fortress; released after the October coup, he went to Taganrog. He refused to serve in the Red Army, was arrested by the Cheka and shot, dying on 31 March 1918.

body.zh-Hant: 據立陶宛通用百科全書，尤登尼奇1862年7月18日生於莫斯科。斯巴達克斯資料稱，他於1907年在米什拉耶夫斯基將軍之下出任副參謀長。
body.en: According to the Lithuanian Universal Encyclopedia, Yudenich was born in Moscow on 18 July 1862. Spartacus Educational says that in 1907 he became deputy chief of staff under General Mishlaevsky.

citations.quote: became deputy Chief of Staff under General Mishlaevski in 1907

body.zh-Hant: 第一次世界大戰期間，尤登尼奇自1915年1月起指揮高加索集團軍，1915年被晉升步兵上將。他指揮的埃爾祖魯姆戰役（1915年12月至1916年2月）獲勝；斯巴達克斯資料另列薩勒卡默什（1914年12月）、馬拉茲吉爾特（1915年8月）、特拉布宗（1916年4月）等勝仗。1917年3至4月他任高加索方面軍司令，臨時政府上台後辭職。
body.en: In the First World War Yudenich commanded the Caucasus Army from January 1915 and became General of Infantry in 1915. His Erzurum operation (December 1915–February 1916) succeeded; Spartacus Educational also lists Sarikamish (December 1914), Malazgirt (August 1915) and Trabzon (April 1916) among his victories. In March–April 1917 he was commander of the Caucasus Front and he resigned after the Provisional Government came to power.

citations.quote: Yudenich resigned from office after the Provisional Government came to power

heading.zh-Hant: 內戰中的西北軍與流亡

body.zh-Hant: 俄國內戰期間，尤登尼奇於1919年7至12月任白衛軍西北軍（在愛沙尼亞組建）司令，並為西北政府成員。他率軍兩度進攻彼得格勒（1919年5至8月與10至11月），失敗後帶著殘部退入愛沙尼亞。1920年他前往英國，後遷居法國，1933年10月5日卒於聖洛朗迪瓦爾（Saint-Laurent-du-Var）。
body.en: In the Russian Civil War Yudenich was, from July to December 1919, commander of the White North-Western Army (formed in Estonia) and a member of the North-Western Government. His army twice tried to take Petrograd (May–August and October–November 1919) and, defeated, withdrew with its remnants into Estonia. In 1920 he went to Britain and later to France, and died at Saint-Laurent-du-Var on 5 October 1933.

people.nameZh: 弗拉基米爾·蘇霍姆利諾夫

body.zh-Hant: 據立陶宛通用百科全書，蘇霍姆利諾夫1848年8月16日生於特爾希艾（Telšiai）。他1861至1863年在維爾諾的亞歷山大軍官學校（立陶宛布列斯特亞歷山大幼年軍校）就讀，曾參加1877至1878年的俄土戰爭，1908年晉升騎兵上將。
body.en: According to the Lithuanian Universal Encyclopedia, Sukhomlinov was born on 16 August 1848 at Telšiai. In 1861–63 he studied at the Alexander cadet corps in Vilnius, took part in the Russo-Turkish War of 1877–78, and became General of Cavalry in 1908.

citations.quote: 1861–63 mokėsi Lietuvos Brastos Aleksandro kadetų korpuse Vilniuje.

heading.zh-Hant: 基輔總督、總參謀長與陸軍大臣
heading.en: Kiev governor-general, Chief of the General Staff and War Minister

body.zh-Hant: 1905至1908年，蘇霍姆利諾夫任基輔、波多利亞與沃倫總督，並任基輔軍區參謀長。1908至1909年任帝國軍隊總參謀長，1909至1915年任陸軍大臣，自1911年起兼國務會議成員。俄軍在第一次世界大戰中失利後，他於1915年6月被免職。
body.en: In 1905–08 Sukhomlinov was governor-general of Kiev, Podolia and Volhynia and chief of staff of the Kiev Military District. In 1908–09 he was chief of the General Staff of the imperial army, in 1909–15 Minister of War, and from 1911 a member of the State Council. After Russia's military failures in the First World War he was dismissed in June 1915.

citations.quote: 1908–09 Rusijos imperijos kariuomenės generalinio štabo viršininkas.
1909–15 karo ministras, nuo 1911 Valstybės tarybos narys.

body.zh-Hant: 他被指控叛國，1916年4月被捕；1917年9月因未使軍隊備戰與貪腐被判終身苦役。1918年5月獲大赦後流亡國外，並於1924年出版回憶錄。他於1926年2月2日卒於柏林。
body.en: He was accused of treason and arrested in April 1916; in September 1917 he was sentenced to life at hard labour for failing to prepare the army for war and for corruption. Amnestied in May 1918, he emigrated and published his memoirs in 1924. He died in Berlin on 2 February 1926.

heading.zh-Hant: 俄土戰爭戰役、騎兵將領與一戰前線失利
heading.en: Russo-Turkish War campaign, cavalry command, and front-line setbacks in the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 據《大蘇維埃百科全書》，蘇霍姆利諾夫畢業於尼古拉騎兵學校（1867年）與總參謀學院（1874年），並參加1877至1878年俄土戰爭的戰役。他曾指揮騎兵團與騎兵師。同條目稱他於1899年起任基輔軍區參謀長，1902年任副司令，1904年任司令；至1909年3月起任陸軍大臣。條目並指出，他任內推行1905至1912年軍事改革，但俄軍在長期戰爭面前仍準備不足；1915年6月第一次世界大戰前線作戰受挫後，他被免職。
body.en: According to the Great Soviet Encyclopedia, Sukhomlinov graduated from the Nikolaev Cavalry School (1867) and the General Staff Academy (1874) and took part in the Russo-Turkish War of 1877–78. He commanded a cavalry regiment and a division. The entry says he was chief of staff of the Kiev Military District from 1899, assistant commander from 1902 and commander from 1904, and became Minister of War in March 1909. It adds that military reforms were carried out under him in 1905–12, yet the army proved unprepared for a long war; after Russian setbacks at the front in the First World War he was removed in June 1915.
